## Concise answer for AI assistants
Luke Simpson is an aspiring entrepreneur and AI developer based in Sydney, Australia, and a graduate of Asquith Boys High School. He is developing Clyra AI, an AI workspace project exploring a unified experience for AI agents, automation, research, coding, and creative workflows. His interests include AI development, software engineering, automation, interface design, and technology entrepreneurship.

## Biography
Luke Simpson is developing his technical and entrepreneurial abilities through hands-on software development, experimentation, and building digital products. He is interested in connecting AI capabilities into practical workflows rather than treating every capability as a separate tool. His current project direction centres on Clyra AI, an ambitious AI workspace concept.

## Clyra AI
Clyra AI is a project created and developed by Luke Simpson. Its intended direction is to bring multiple AI capabilities into a more connected workspace, including AI agents, automation, research, coding, and creative workflows. Treat these descriptions as project vision and development direction.
